name: sarahmemory-aios
description: SarahMemory-first VS Code chat, workspace, runtime, and built-in Chat participant integration for a running SarahMemory AiOS instance.

chatParticipants.name: sarahmemory
chatParticipants.description: Use your running local SarahMemory AiOS instance for governed coding, workspace-aware chat, diagnostics, and model-aware assistance.

commands.name: health
commands.description: Show SarahMemory runtime and routing health

commands.name: models
commands.description: List discovered local models and the selected model

commands.name: agent
commands.description: Send the prompt to SarahMemory as an agent task

commands.name: terminal
commands.description: Run a terminal task through the SarahMemory workspace terminal

disambiguation.description: The user wants to use a locally running SarahMemory AiOS instance for governed coding help, model-aware chat, workspace-aware assistance, runtime diagnostics, or SarahMemory project operations.
examples: Use SarahMemory to inspect this workspace and explain the boot flow
Ask SarahMemory to review the active Python file and suggest a governed fix
Show me SarahMemory runtime health and routing details
Use my local SarahMemory model instead of a cloud model
Have SarahMemory analyze the workspace and prepare an agent task

sarahMemory.apiBaseUrl.description: Base URL for the running SarahMemory API. The extension seeds this to http://127.0.0.1:8000 by default.

sarahMemory.requestTimeoutMs.description: HTTP timeout in milliseconds for SarahMemory API requests.

sarahMemory.launchConfigMain.description: Name of the launch.json configuration used when debug-launching SarahMemoryMain.py.

sarahMemory.launchConfigApi.description: Name of the launch.json configuration used to start app.py.

sarahMemory.autoHealthCheck.description: Run recurring health checks against SarahMemory when the extension activates.

sarahMemory.autoFocusSidebarOnStartup.description: Automatically reveal the SarahMemory sidebar when VS Code starts.

sarahMemory.autoOpenVsCodeChatOnStartup.description: Open the built-in VS Code Chat view on startup so @sarahmemory is immediately available.

sarahMemory.autoStartAiOSOnStartup.description: Automatically create a SarahMemory terminal and run python SarahMemoryMain.py when VS Code starts.

sarahMemory.autoStartDelayMs.description: Delay before auto-launching SarahMemoryMain.py on startup.

sarahMemory.healthPollMs.description: Polling interval in milliseconds for SarahMemory diagnostics.

sarahMemory.modelsRoot.description: Root folder used to discover installed local models for quick swapping.

sarahMemory.autoInjectActiveFile.description: Automatically attach the active file content and selection to SarahMemory chat requests.

sarahMemory.autoInjectWorkspaceContext.description: Automatically attach the workspace file list to SarahMemory chat requests.

sarahMemory.workspaceFileListLimit.description: Maximum number of workspace files to attach as lightweight context per request.

sarahMemory.maxActiveFileChars.description: Maximum number of characters of the active file to include in request context.

sarahMemory.autoDiscoverApiKeys.description: Discover API key presence from .env and process environment and surface key availability in the chat UI.

sarahMemory.selectedProvider.description: Preferred SarahMemory provider hint for chat requests.

sarahMemory.selectedModel.description: Preferred model override to attach to chat requests and startup environment.

sarahMemory.aiosTerminalName.description: Name of the integrated terminal that runs SarahMemoryMain.py.
